. do /Users/jiayuanren/项目规划/.worktrees/codex-v1811-m1/tests/fixtures/arma_g
> arch_joint/generate.do /Users/jiayuanren/项目规划/.worktrees/codex-v1811-m1/t
> ests/fixtures/arma_garch_joint/oracle_v1 

. // VERIFICATION LEVEL: independent Stata 18 normal ARCH likelihood oracle.
. // Usage: stata-mp -b do generate.do <fresh output directory>
. version 18

. set more off

. args output

. cd "`output'"
/Users/jiayuanren/项目规划/.worktrees/codex-v1811-m1/tests/fixtures/arma_garch_
> joint/oracle_v1

. set seed 181104

. foreach case in garch11_constant garch11_zero garch21_constant arch2_constant
>  {
  2.     clear
  3.     local N = cond("`case'" == "garch11_constant",2540,1800)
  4.     set obs `N'
  5.     generate long t = _n
  6.     generate double h = 1
  7.     generate double e = 0
  8.     generate double u = 0
  9.     local mu = cond("`case'" == "garch11_zero",0,2)
 10.     forvalues i = 3/`N' {
 11.         if "`case'" == "arch2_constant" {
 12.             quietly replace h = .5 + .3*e[`i'-1]^2 + .15*e[`i'-2]^2 in `i'
 13.         }
 14.         else {
 15.             quietly replace h = .15 + .18*e[`i'-1]^2 + .67*h[`i'-1] in `i'
 16.         }
 17.         quietly replace e = sqrt(h)*rnormal() in `i'
 18.         quietly replace u = .55*u[`i'-1] + .35*e[`i'-1] + e in `i'
 19.         if "`case'" == "garch21_constant" {
 20.             quietly replace u = u - .2*u[`i'-2] in `i'
 21.         }
 22.     }
 23.     generate double y = `mu' + u
 24.     tsset t
 25.     format y %24.17g
 26.     export delimited t y using data_`case'.csv, replace
 27.     local ar "ar(1)"
 28.     local variance "arch(1) garch(1)"
 29.     local constant ""
 30.     if "`case'" == "garch21_constant" local ar "ar(1/2)"
 31.     if "`case'" == "arch2_constant" local variance "arch(1/2)"
 32.     if "`case'" == "garch11_zero" local constant "noconstant"
 33.     foreach vce in opg oim robust {
 34.         quietly arch y, `ar' ma(1) `variance' `constant' arch0(xb) arma0(z
> ero) vce(`vce') tolerance(1e-12) ltolerance(1e-12) nrtolerance(1e-8) iterate(
> 500)
 35.         matrix b = e(b)
 36.         matrix V = e(V)
 37.         local k = colsof(b)
 38.         file open out using stata_`case'_`vce'.tsv, write replace
 39.         file write out "ll" _tab %24.17g (e(ll)) _n
 40.         file write out "nobs" _tab %24.17g (e(N)) _n
 41.         file write out "converged" _tab %24.17g (e(converged)) _n
 42.         forvalues i=1/`k' {
 43.             file write out "b`i'" _tab %24.17g (b[1,`i']) _n
 44.             file write out "se`i'" _tab %24.17g (sqrt(V[`i',`i'])) _n
 45.             forvalues j=1/`k' {
 46.                 file write out "v`i'_`j'" _tab %24.17g (V[`i',`j']) _n
 47.             }
 48.         }
 49.         file close out
 50.         predict double residual_`vce', residuals
 51.         predict double variance_`vce', variance
 52.     }
 53.     export delimited t residual_* variance_* using series_`case'.csv, repl
> ace
 54. }
